edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deployer becomes the authority root.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner modifier check.
onlyOwner gates the ownership transfer entry point.
onlyOwner gates setting the liquidation manager.
onlyOwner gates changing handler support.
onlyOwner gates owner reward token transfer.
onlyBreaker gates the circuit breaker toggle.
breakerTable[msg.sender].auth is read by onlyBreaker.
msg.sender indexes the breakerTable authorization mapping.
operators mapping is read by the onlyOperators check.
msg.sender is checked against the operators mapping and owner.
onlyOperators gates the reward parameter update entry point.
msg.sender is compared to the configured liquidation manager.
onlyLiquidationManager gates partial liquidation of a user.
onlyLiquidationManager gates liquidation reward distribution.
dataStorageInstance.getLiquidationManagerAddr result is compared to msg.sender.
onlyHandler resolves msg.sender against the registered handler address.
emergency flag determines whether circuitBreaker restricts callers.
Constructor authorizes owner and a breaker in breakerTable.

flashloanAddr is the delegatecall target for flashloan logic.
